# Ricoh Global
> This is the corporate website for Ricoh Company, Ltd. and the Ricoh Group. It provides information on the company, shareholders and investors, sustainability, technology, products, support, and news.
## About Ricoh
- [About Ricoh](https://www.ricoh.com/about): A page compiling links to corporate information, including the vision, company overview, affiliated companies, and integrated reports.
- [To Our Stakeholders](https://www.ricoh.com/about/to-our-stakeholders)
- [Corporate Philosophy](https://www.ricoh.com/about/ricoh-way)
- [Company Data](https://www.ricoh.com/about/facts)
- [The Board](https://www.ricoh.com/about/facts/board)
- [Organization](https://www.ricoh.com/about/organization)
- [Directory](https://www.ricoh.com/about/location)
- [Global Network](https://www.ricoh.com/about/global-network)
- [Company History](https://www.ricoh.com/about/history)
- [Ricoh at a Glance](https://www.ricoh.com/about/at-a-glance)
- [Integrated Report](https://www.ricoh.com/about/integrated-report)
## Investor Relations
- [Investor Relations](https://www.ricoh.com/IR): A page compiling links to information for shareholders and investors.
- [IR News](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/news)
- [Corporate Strategy Meeting](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/events/investors-meeting)
- [Business Briefing/ESG Briefing](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/events/business-briefing)
- [Financial Announcement](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/events/earning)
- [Financial Results](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/library/financial-results)
- [Securities Reports](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/library/securities-report)
- [General Meeting](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/events/general-meeting)
- [Stock Information](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/stock/stock-information)
- [Shareholder Returns](https://www.ricoh.com/IR/stock/shareholder-returns)
## Sustainability
- [Sustainability](https://www.ricoh.com/sustainability): A page compiling links to information on sustainability.
- [Environment](https://www.ricoh.com/sustainability/environment)
- [Society](https://www.ricoh.com/sustainability/society)
- [Governance](https://www.ricoh.com/sustainability/governance)
- [Information Security](https://www.ricoh.com/sustainability/governance/security)
## Products & Services
- [Products & Services](https://www.ricoh.com/products): A page compiling links to our products and solutions.
## Technology
- [Technology](https://www.ricoh.com/technology): A page compiling links to technical information.
- [Development](https://www.ricoh.com/technology/rd)
- [Ricoh's Technology](https://www.ricoh.com/technology/tech)
## Support & Downloads
- [Support & Downloads](https://www.ricoh.com/support): This page consolidates support and download information.
## Ricoh Global Newsroom
- [News](https://www.ricoh.com/news): A page compiling links to our news.
- [News Release](https://www.ricoh.com/release)
- [Information](https://www.ricoh.com/info)
- [Stories](https://www.ricoh.com/news/stories): The official web magazine delivering the latest activities and updates from Ricoh.
## Optional
- [Ricoh Corporate Website](https://jp.ricoh.com): The Japanese-language corporate and investor relations website of Ricoh Company, Ltd. and the Ricoh Group.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ricohgroup): Ricoh's official LinkedIn page.

Main content
​
​

Fulfillment can be defined as a feeling gained from achievement and self-development.
RICOH enables individuals to work smarter, and by providing fulfillment through work, we will enhance the quality of life.

Learn more

Please select your local Ricoh website

Ricoh Group operates in approximately 200 countries and regions with a headquarter in Tokyo, Japan.

Select country / language

From the USA?

We recommend visiting our US website for locally available products, services, and information.

Ricoh USA

About RICOH

To Our Stakeholders

Ricoh has remained close to the changing nature of work since its founding in 1936.
We will continue to drive innovation, support the creativity of working people, and realize “Fulfillment through Work.”
